title: Three Words on an Envelope
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：price　|　正文 331 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 price 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My mother ran a small shop for thirty-one years and she could tell you the ① price of everything in it, which is not the same as knowing what anything was worth. She said the ② price of a thing is what the last person paid for it, and that this is why prices in a small town move so slowly: the last person is always somebody's neighbour. In 1998 a man from the city offered to buy the shop, and she asked him to ③ put a price on the window — by which she meant the view of the church — and he did not understand her.

There was a basin in the back room, chipped, which she refused to sell at any ④ price, and which I have now on my own shelf. She said some things are ⑤ beyond price, and then, seeing my face, said that this only means nobody has yet offered enough. The only ⑥ price she ever wrote down was three words on the back of an envelope, and she tore it up the same week.

The ⑦ price of keeping the shop open, as she counted it, was eleven hours a day and no holiday for nine years, and she paid it without ever saying so. My father said the real ⑧ price was paid by him and me, which I think is true and which I also think was unfair of him to say. At a ⑨ price, she used to say, everything in the world is for sale, and the trick is knowing which price is yours.
Nobody ⑩ pays the price for a shop in a single sum; it comes out of you weekly, like rent, and you do not notice it going.

When she died, in 2011, my sister and I sold the stock in a day and the shop in a week. The price we got was less than the man from the city had offered in 1998, which my sister found unbearable and I did not.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 代价；牺牲（the price of ...）
C. 固定搭配：at a price 以相当高的代价；以某种代价
D. 固定搭配：at any price 不惜任何代价
E. 固定搭配：beyond / above price 无价的；极珍贵的
F. 固定搭配：pay the price (for sth.) 为……付出代价
G. 固定搭配：put a price on sth. 给……定价；估量……的价值
H. n. 标价；要价；价目（the asking price）

items.q: the price of everything in it
the price of a thing is what the last person paid
put a price on the window
refused to sell at any price
The only price she ever wrote down
The price of keeping the shop open
the real price was paid by him and me
At a price, she used to say
pays the price for a shop in a single sum

answers.why: the price of ... 意为“……的价格”，母亲能说出店里每样东西的价钱。
price 意为“价格”，她说一样东西的价格就是上一位顾客付的数目。
put a price on sth. 意为“给某物估价”，她让城里人给那扇窗（望见教堂的景）估个价。
at any price 意为“不惜任何代价”，说她绝不肯卖那只盆。
beyond price 意为“无价的、极珍贵的”，她说有些东西是无价的。
price 意为“标价、写下的价目”，她一生只写下过一次价，写在信封背面。
the price of ... 意为“……的代价”，开店三十一年的代价是一天十一小时、九年没休假。
the real price 意为“真正的代价”，父亲说真正的代价是我和他付的。
at a price 意为“以某种代价”，她说世上万事都可以卖，代价各有不同。
pay the price (for sth.) 意为“为……付出代价”，开店的代价不是一次付清的。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我母亲能说出店里每样东西的价格。（price）
她说，一样东西的价格就是上一位顾客付的数目。（price）
她让那个城里人给那扇窗估个价。（put a price on）
她绝不以任何代价卖掉那只盆。（at any price）
她说有些东西是无价的。（beyond price）
谁也不会一次性付清开一家店的代价。（pay the price）
answers: My mother could tell you the price of everything in the shop.
She said the price of a thing is what the last person paid for it.
She asked the man from the city to put a price on the window.
She refused to sell the basin at any price.
She said some things are beyond price.
Nobody pays the price for a shop in a single sum.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 price 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My mother ran a small shop for thirty-one years and could tell you the price of everything in it.
She said the price of a thing is what the last person paid for it, and in a small town the last person is always a neighbour.
She asked the man from the city to put a price on the window, meaning the view of the church.
The chipped basin in the back room she refused to sell at any price, though she said nothing is really beyond price.
The price of keeping the shop open was eleven hours a day and no holiday for nine years.
Nobody pays the price for a shop in a single sum; it comes out of you weekly, like rent.
